about: Two planted defects in knowledge recall, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: freshness is measured with one look at the index per claim instead of one for all of them; and the recall trusts the freshness each claim was stamped with when it was recorded, never measuring it now.

mutations.find: const scopes = measure(claims.map((c) => ({ scope: watched(c) })), ctx.know.model().model, ctx.source);
mutations.replace: const scopes = Object.assign({}, ...claims.map((c) => measure([{ scope: watched(c) }], ctx.know.model().model, ctx.source)));
